title.en: Customary land dispute: start at LC1
title.lg: Enjawulo y'ettaka ery'obutonde: tandikira ku LC1
title.sw: Mgogoro wa ardhi ya kimila: anzia LC1

answer.en: For customary (untitled) land boundary disputes, go to the LC1 Civil Court first. NOT the Police. NOT LC2. The LC1 court hears the case with elders as witnesses. Only appeal upward if you disagree with the decision.
answer.lg: Ku enjawulo z'ensalo z'ettaka ery'obutonde (eritalina title), sooka ogende mu kkooti ya LC1. SI ku Poliisi. SI ku LC2. Kkooti ya LC1 ewulira omusango ng'abakadde baliwo ng'abajulizi. Ojulira waggulu kwokka bw'oba tolina matizigavu.
answer.sw: Kwa migogoro ya mipaka ya ardhi ya kimila (isiyo na hati), anza Mahakama ya LC1. SI Polisi. SI LC2. Mahakama ya LC1 husikiliza shauri na wazee kama mashahidi. Kata rufaa kwenda juu tu usipokubaliana na uamuzi.

illegal_practices.en: Police have no power to decide land ownership. An officer who demands money to settle your boundary is breaking the law. Report to the District Police Commander.
illegal_practices.lg: Poliisi terina buyinza kusalawo nannyini ttaka. Omuserikale asaba ssente okumala ensalo yo amenya mateeka. Mumanyise ku District Police Commander.
illegal_practices.sw: Polisi haina mamlaka kuamua umiliki wa ardhi. Afisa anayedai pesa kumaliza mpaka wako anavunja sheria. Mrripoti kwa Kamanda wa Polisi wa Wilaya.

en: Gather your evidence: elders, family minutes, old agreements
File the case at your LC1 Civil Court
Attend the hearing on the land itself with your witnesses
lg: Kuŋŋaanya obujulizi bwo: abakadde, ebiwandiiko by'amaka, endagaano enkadde
Ggulawo omusango mu kkooti ya LC1 yo
Genda mu kuwulira okubeera ku ttaka lyennyini ng'olina abajulizi bo
sw: Kusanya ushahidi wako: wazee, kumbukumbu za familia, makubaliano ya zamani
Fungua shauri Mahakama ya LC1 yako
Hudhuria usikilizaji unaofanyika kwenye ardhi yenyewe na mashahidi wako

question.en: Did you know? Customary land fights start at the LC1 court, not Police.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Entalo z'ettaka ery'obutonde zitandikira mu kkooti ya LC1, si ku Poliisi.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mapigano ya ardhi ya kimila huanzia mahakama ya LC1, si Polisi.

answer.en: Yes. Land Act Cap 227, Section 41. Bring elders as witnesses.
answer.lg: Yee. Land Act Cap 227, Section 41. Leeta abakadde ng'abajulizi.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Land Act Cap 227, Kifungu cha 41. Leta wazee kama mashahidi.

title.en: Mailo and titled land: go to the Land Board
title.lg: Ettaka lya mailo n'eririna title: genda ku Land Board
title.sw: Ardhi ya mailo na yenye hati: nenda Bodi ya Ardhi

answer.en: For mailo or registered (titled) land disputes, go to the District Land Board. NOT LC1 — LC1 has no power over titled land. Carry your title deed or sale agreement. The Board will guide you to mediation or court.
answer.lg: Ku enjawulo z'ettaka lya mailo oba eririna title, genda ku District Land Board. SI ku LC1 — LC1 terina buyinza ku ttaka eririna title. Twala title deed yo oba endagaano y'okutunda. Olukiiko lujja kukulungamya mu kuteesa oba mu kkooti.
answer.sw: Kwa migogoro ya ardhi ya mailo au yenye hati, nenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya. SI LC1 — LC1 haina mamlaka juu ya ardhi yenye hati. Beba hati yako au mkataba wa mauzo. Bodi itakuongoza kwenye upatanishi au mahakama.

illegal_practices.en: Anyone selling you titled land without showing the original title deed is likely a fraudster. Never pay for land you have not verified at the land registry.
illegal_practices.lg: Omuntu yenna akutundira ettaka eririna title nga takulaze title deed entuufu ayinza okuba omufere. Tosasa ssente ku ttaka gy'otokezezza ku land registry.
illegal_practices.sw: Mtu yeyote anayekuuza ardhi yenye hati bila kukuonyesha hati halisi huenda ni tapeli. Usilipe pesa kwa ardhi ambayo hujaihakiki kwenye sajili ya ardhi.

en: Get a copy of the title deed from the seller
Verify it at the district land registry (free search)
File your complaint at the District Land Board
lg: Funa koppi ya title deed okuva ku mutunzi
Gikeze ku land registry ya disitulikiti (okukebera kwa bwereere)
Ggulawo okwemulugunya kwo ku District Land Board
sw: Pata nakala ya hati kutoka kwa muuzaji
Ihakiki kwenye sajili ya ardhi ya wilaya (utafutaji ni bure)
Fungua malalamiko yako Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya

question.en: Did you know? LC1 cannot decide cases about titled land.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? LC1 teyinza kusalawo misango gy'ettaka eririna title.
question.sw: Ulijua? LC1 haiwezi kuamua mashauri ya ardhi yenye hati.

answer.en: True. Titled and mailo land goes to the District Land Board. Land Act Cap 227, Section 42.
answer.lg: Mazima. Ettaka eririna title ne mailo bigenda ku District Land Board. Land Act Cap 227, Section 42.
answer.sw: Kweli. Ardhi yenye hati na mailo huenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya. Land Act Cap 227, Kifungu cha 42.

answer.en: To register land: bring your national ID, the sale agreement with LC1 stamp, a survey site plan, and an LC1 introductory letter to the district land office. Pay the official fees and get a receipt for everything. A full title takes several months. Never pay a broker to speed it up.
answer.lg: Okuwandiisa ettaka: leeta ID yo ey'eggwanga, endagaano y'okutunda erina sitampu ya LC1, site plan ey'ekipimo, n'ebbaluwa ya LC1 eri omukulembeze, eri offiisi y'ettaka eya disitulikiti. Sasula ssente entuufu era ofune risiti ku buli kimu. Title ennamba etwala emyezi egiwera. Tosasa muntu yenna okwanguyiza.
answer.sw: Kusajili ardhi: leta kitambulisho chako cha taifa, mkataba wa mauzo wenye muhuri wa LC1, ramani ya upimaji, na barua ya utambulisho ya LC1, hadi ofisi ya ardhi ya wilaya. Lipa ada rasmi na upate risiti kwa kila kitu. Hati kamili huchukua miezi kadhaa. Usimlipe dalali kuharakisha.

legal_citation: Land Act Cap 227; Registration of Titles Act
correct_authority: District Land Office / Registrar of Titles

illegal_practices.en: No officer may keep your original documents or demand extra cash for speed. Always get a receipt. Photocopy everything before you hand it over.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali muserikale akkirizibwa kukwata ebbaluwa zo entuufu oba okusaba ssente endala okwanguyiza. Bulijjo funa risiti. Koppiya buli kimu nga tonnaba kubiwaayo.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna afisa anayeruhusiwa kushika nyaraka zako halisi au kudai pesa za ziada kuharakisha. Kila wakati pata risiti. Nakili kila kitu kabla ya kukabidhi.

en: Collect your ID, stamped agreement, site plan and LC1 letter
Submit them at the district land office and pay official fees
Keep all receipts and follow up monthly until the title is out
lg: Kuŋŋaanya ID yo, endagaano erina sitampu, site plan n'ebbaluwa ya LC1
Zitwale ku offiisi y'ettaka eya disitulikiti era osasule ssente entuufu
Kwata risiti zonna era obuuzeeko buli mwezi okutu title lw'erifuluma
sw: Kusanya kitambulisho chako, mkataba uliopigwa muhuri, ramani na barua ya LC1
Ziwasilishe ofisi ya ardhi ya wilaya na ulipe ada rasmi
Hifadhi risiti zote na ufuatilie kila mwezi hadi hati itoke

question.en: Did you know? Always get a receipt for every land fee you pay.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Bulijjo funa risiti ku buli ssente z'osasula ku ttaka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kila wakati pata risiti kwa kila ada ya ardhi unayolipa.

answer.en: Yes. No receipt means no proof. Photocopy all documents first.
answer.lg: Yee. Awatali risiti tewali bujulizi. Soooka okoppiye ebbaluwa zonna.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Hakuna risiti hakuna uthibitisho. Nakili nyaraka zote kwanza.

title.en: What makes a land sale agreement valid
title.lg: Ekikola endagaano y'okutunda ettaka okuba entuufu
title.sw: Kinachofanya mkataba wa mauzo ya ardhi kuwa halali

answer.en: A valid land sale needs: names and IDs of buyer and seller, the exact size and location of the land, the agreed price, signatures of both sides plus witnesses, and the LC1 stamp. The LC1 stamp costs a flat 10,000 UGX. It is NOT a percentage of the sale price. Anyone charging a percentage is cheating you.
answer.lg: Endagaano entuufu ey'okutunda ettaka yeetaaga: amannya ne ID z'omuguzi n'omutunzi, obunene n'ekifo kyennyini eky'ettaka, omuwendo gwe mukkiriziganyizzaako, emikono gyombi n'egy'abajulizi, ne sitampu ya LC1. Sitampu ya LC1 ya UGX 10,000 zokka, ssente nnyiriri. SI kitundu ku muwendo gw'okutunda. Asaba ekitundu akulimbalimba.
answer.sw: Mkataba halali wa mauzo ya ardhi unahitaji: majina na vitambulisho vya mnunuzi na muuzaji, ukubwa na mahali kamili pa ardhi, bei mliyokubaliana, sahihi za pande zote mbili pamoja na mashahidi, na muhuri wa LC1. Muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 taslimu. SI asilimia ya bei ya mauzo. Anayedai asilimia anakutapeli.

legal_citation: Land Act Cap 227; Local Government (Fees) Regulations

illegal_practices.en: The LC1 stamp is a flat 10,000 UGX by law. Any chairman asking for 5% or 10% of your land price is extorting you. Refuse and report to LC2.
illegal_practices.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 ya UGX 10,000 zokka ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Ssentebe asaba ekitundu ku muwendo gw'ettaka lyo akutunza bubbi. Gaana era mumanyise ku LC2.
illegal_practices.sw: Muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 taslimu kisheria. Mwenyekiti anayedai asilimia ya bei ya ardhi yako anakunyang'anya. Kataa na umrripoti kwa LC2.

en: Write the agreement with full names, IDs, land size and price
Sign with witnesses from both families present
Take it to LC1 for the 10,000 UGX stamp and keep a copy each
lg: Wandiika endagaano ng'erimu amannya gonna, ID, obunene bw'ettaka n'omuwendo
Ssaako omukono ng'abajulizi b'enju zombi baliwo
Gitwale ku LC1 ofune sitampu ya UGX 10,000 era buli omu akvateko koppi
sw: Andika mkataba ukiwa na majina kamili, vitambulisho, ukubwa wa ardhi na bei
Saini mukiwa na mashahidi kutoka familia zote mbili
Upeleke LC1 upate muhuri wa UGX 10,000 na kila mtu ahifadhi nakala

question.en: Did you know? The LC1 stamp is 10,000 UGX flat. Never a percentage.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Sitampu ya LC1 ya UGX 10,000 zokka. Si kitundu ku muwendo.
question.sw: Ulijua? Muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 taslimu. Kamwe si asilimia.

answer.en: True. If you are asked to pay a percentage of the sale price, it is not legal.
answer.lg: Mazima. Bw'osabibwa okusasula ekitundu ku muwendo gw'okutunda, tekiri mu mateeka.
answer.sw: Kweli. Ukidaiwa kulipa asilimia ya bei ya mauzo, si halali.
